text: 【10月PMI进入收缩区间 受季节性因素影响企业生产经营放缓】10月31日，国家统计局公布的数据显示，10月份，制造业采购经理指数、非制造业商务活动指数和综合PMI产出指数分别为49.3%、49.7%和49.7%，比上月下降0.8个、0.5个和1.0个百分点。从历史数据来看，受季节性因素影响，往年同期指数多有下降。
text_en: [October PMI enters contraction territory; seasonal factors slow corporate production and operations] On October 31, data released by the National Bureau of Statistics showed that in October the manufacturing PMI, non-manufacturing business activity index and composite PMI output index were 49.3%, 49.7% and 49.7%, respectively, down 0.8, 0.5 and 1.0 percentage points from the previous month. Historical data show that affected by seasonal factors, the indices mostly declined in the same period in previous years.
